process.rule:
title: live fixture process_creation
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\services.exe'
  condition: sel
process.vql:
-- Sigma "live fixture process_creation" → pslist(): running processes only, not process history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET ByPid <= memoize(query={ SELECT Pid, Exe, CommandLine FROM pslist() }, key="Pid")
LET Procs <= SELECT Pid, Ppid, Name, Exe AS Image, CommandLine, Username AS User, get(item=ByPid, field=str(str=Ppid)).Exe AS ParentImage, get(item=ByPid, field=str(str=Ppid)).CommandLine AS ParentCommandLine FROM pslist()
SELECT * FROM Procs
WHERE (Image =~ "(?i)\\\\svchost\\.exe$" AND ParentImage =~ "(?i)\\\\services\\.exe$")

-- Sigma "live fixture process_creation" → Sysmon event 1, or Security 4688 where Sysmon is absent: process history as far back as the endpoint's event logs go
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET SysmonLog <= "C:/Windows/System32/winevt/Logs/Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon%4Operational.evtx"
LET SecurityLog <= "C:/Windows/System32/winevt/Logs/Security.evtx"
LET SysmonEvents = SELECT timestamp(epoch=System.TimeCreated.SystemTime) AS EventTime, "Sysmon" AS Source, EventData.Image AS Image, EventData.CommandLine AS CommandLine, EventData.ProcessId AS ProcessId, EventData.ParentProcessId AS ParentProcessId, EventData.User AS User, EventData.ParentImage AS ParentImage, EventData.ParentCommandLine AS ParentCommandLine, EventData.Hashes AS Hashes, EventData.OriginalFileName AS OriginalFileName, EventData.IntegrityLevel AS IntegrityLevel, EventData.CurrentDirectory AS CurrentDirectory, EventData.Description AS Description, EventData.Product AS Product, EventData.Company AS Company FROM foreach(row={ SELECT OSPath FROM glob(globs=SysmonLog) }, query={ SELECT * FROM parse_evtx(filename=OSPath) WHERE System.EventID.Value = 1 })
LET SecurityEvents = SELECT timestamp(epoch=System.TimeCreated.SystemTime) AS EventTime, "Security" AS Source, EventData.NewProcessName AS Image, EventData.CommandLine AS CommandLine, int(int=EventData.NewProcessId) AS ProcessId, int(int=EventData.ProcessId) AS ParentProcessId, EventData.SubjectDomainName + "\\" + EventData.SubjectUserName AS User, EventData.ParentProcessName AS ParentImage, NULL AS ParentCommandLine, NULL AS Hashes, NULL AS OriginalFileName, NULL AS IntegrityLevel, NULL AS CurrentDirectory, NULL AS Description, NULL AS Product, NULL AS Company FROM foreach(row={ SELECT OSPath FROM glob(globs=SecurityLog) }, query={ SELECT * FROM parse_evtx(filename=OSPath) WHERE System.EventID.Value = 4688 })
LET HasSysmon <= SELECT count() AS N FROM SysmonEvents LIMIT 1
LET ProcEvents <= SELECT * FROM if(condition=HasSysmon[0].N > 0, then=SysmonEvents, else=SecurityEvents)
SELECT * FROM ProcEvents
WHERE (Image =~ "(?i)\\\\svchost\\.exe$" AND ParentImage =~ "(?i)\\\\services\\.exe$")

processHashes.rule:
title: live fixture process_creation
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    Hashes|contains: 'a'
  condition: sel
processHashes.vql:
-- Sigma "live fixture process_creation" → pslist(): running processes only, not process history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Procs <= SELECT Pid, Ppid, Name, Exe AS Image, CommandLine, Username AS User, hash(path=Exe) AS Hashes FROM pslist()
SELECT * FROM Procs
WHERE (Image =~ "(?i)\\\\svchost\\.exe$" AND (Hashes.MD5 =~ "(?i)a" OR Hashes.SHA1 =~ "(?i)a" OR Hashes.SHA256 =~ "(?i)a"))

-- Sigma "live fixture process_creation" → Sysmon event 1 only: the rule uses fields Security 4688 does not record, so an endpoint without Sysmon cannot answer it
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET SysmonLog <= "C:/Windows/System32/winevt/Logs/Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon%4Operational.evtx"
LET SecurityLog <= "C:/Windows/System32/winevt/Logs/Security.evtx"
LET SysmonEvents = SELECT timestamp(epoch=System.TimeCreated.SystemTime) AS EventTime, "Sysmon" AS Source, EventData.Image AS Image, EventData.CommandLine AS CommandLine, EventData.ProcessId AS ProcessId, EventData.ParentProcessId AS ParentProcessId, EventData.User AS User, EventData.ParentImage AS ParentImage, EventData.ParentCommandLine AS ParentCommandLine, EventData.Hashes AS Hashes, EventData.OriginalFileName AS OriginalFileName, EventData.IntegrityLevel AS IntegrityLevel, EventData.CurrentDirectory AS CurrentDirectory, EventData.Description AS Description, EventData.Product AS Product, EventData.Company AS Company FROM foreach(row={ SELECT OSPath FROM glob(globs=SysmonLog) }, query={ SELECT * FROM parse_evtx(filename=OSPath) WHERE System.EventID.Value = 1 })
LET SecurityEvents = SELECT timestamp(epoch=System.TimeCreated.SystemTime) AS EventTime, "Security" AS Source, EventData.NewProcessName AS Image, EventData.CommandLine AS CommandLine, int(int=EventData.NewProcessId) AS ProcessId, int(int=EventData.ProcessId) AS ParentProcessId, EventData.SubjectDomainName + "\\" + EventData.SubjectUserName AS User, EventData.ParentProcessName AS ParentImage, NULL AS ParentCommandLine, NULL AS Hashes, NULL AS OriginalFileName, NULL AS IntegrityLevel, NULL AS CurrentDirectory, NULL AS Description, NULL AS Product, NULL AS Company FROM foreach(row={ SELECT OSPath FROM glob(globs=SecurityLog) }, query={ SELECT * FROM parse_evtx(filename=OSPath) WHERE System.EventID.Value = 4688 })
LET HasSysmon <= SELECT count() AS N FROM SysmonEvents LIMIT 1
LET ProcEvents <= SELECT * FROM SysmonEvents
SELECT * FROM ProcEvents
WHERE (Image =~ "(?i)\\\\svchost\\.exe$" AND Hashes =~ "(?i)a")

netPort.rule:
title: live fixture network_connection
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    DestinationPort|gte: 1
    Image|endswith: '.exe'
  condition: sel
netPort.vql:
-- Sigma "live fixture network_connection" → netstat(): open connections only, not connection history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET ByPid <= memoize(query={ SELECT Pid, Exe FROM pslist() }, key="Pid")
LET Conns <= SELECT Pid, Status, Laddr.IP AS SourceIp, Laddr.Port AS SourcePort, Raddr.IP AS DestinationIp, Raddr.Port AS DestinationPort, get(item=ByPid, field=str(str=Pid)).Exe AS Image FROM netstat()
SELECT * FROM Conns
WHERE (DestinationPort >= 1 AND Image =~ "(?i)\\.exe$")

netCidr.rule:
title: live fixture network_connection
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    DestinationIp|cidr:
      - '10.0.0.0/8'
      - '192.168.0.0/16'
      - '172.16.0.0/12'
  condition: sel
netCidr.vql:
-- Sigma "live fixture network_connection" → netstat(): open connections only, not connection history
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Conns <= SELECT Pid, Status, Laddr.IP AS SourceIp, Laddr.Port AS SourcePort, Raddr.IP AS DestinationIp, Raddr.Port AS DestinationPort FROM netstat()
SELECT * FROM Conns
WHERE cidr_contains(ip=DestinationIp, ranges=["10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.0.0/16", "172.16.0.0/12"])

file.rule:
title: live fixture file_event
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    TargetFilename: 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe'
  condition: sel
file.vql:
-- Sigma "live fixture file_event" → glob(): files on disk now under C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Files <= SELECT OSPath AS TargetFilename, Size, Mtime FROM glob(globs=["C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe"])
SELECT * FROM Files
WHERE TargetFilename =~ "(?i)^C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd\\.exe$"

registry.rule:
title: live fixture registry_set
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  sel:
    TargetObject|startswith: 'HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
    Details|contains: 'Windows'
  condition: sel
registry.vql:
-- Sigma "live fixture registry_set" → glob(accessor="registry"): registry keys and values as they are now under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*, HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*/**
-- Compiled by DFIR Companion from a Sigma rule; the same rule always yields this VQL
LET Keys <= SELECT OSPath AS TargetObject, Data.value AS Details, Mtime FROM glob(globs=["HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/Software/Microsoft/Windows NT/CurrentVersion*/**"], accessor="registry")
SELECT * FROM Keys
WHERE (TargetObject =~ "(?i)^HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows NT\\\\CurrentVersion" AND Details =~ "(?i)Windows")
